title: [review] tx_queue.py:403: pop() signals reservation succ
description: When pop() removes an entry, it signals entry.reservation.set_result(True) at line 405 but never increments stats.packets_transmitted or updates latency stats (avg_latency_ms, max_latency_ms). In contrast, complete() does both. If code uses push(return_reservation=True) followed by pop(), the awaiting caller receives success but packets_transmitted is not incremented, creating inconsistent statistics.
close_reason: Fixed: pop() now calls _remove_first() to update packets_transmitted, max_latency_ms, and avg_latency_ms consistently with reservation success signal. Updated test to verify new behavior.
